note.zh: 打捞五天后，机器人记忆严重损坏、无法读取，“遗弃机器人”标本入库，其来历仍是谜。
note.en: Five days later, the robot's memory proves too damaged to read; the Castaway Robot specimen is recorded and its fate remains a mystery.

scope.zh: 异常定义（生成条件、等级、次数限制）与全部结果事件已对照源文件核对。
scope.en: Anomaly definition (spawn conditions, level, once-limits) and every outcome event checked against the source.
